title: Nvidia scandal could help China long-term, and risks in the AI trade
summary:
Deidre Bosa tackles the hottest tech and AI headlines, beginning with the long-term win China might get from the Nvidia (NVDA) scandal. Risks in the AI trade and how this all could affect the US-China relationship.

Deidre Bosa then sits down with Sierra co-founder Clay Bavor and OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) chairman Bret Taylor to discuss doubts about the data center rollout and the competition between the US and China in the AI race.

'Deirdre Bosa Live' airs every day at 4 p.m. Tune in daily to hear how the latest developments in AI and technology are reshaping companies, industries, and the global economy.

title: AI infrastructure spending is still accelerating—but can it last?
summary: Bernstein Managing Director and Senior Analyst Stacy Rasgon joins Deirdre Bosa Live to break down the biggest risks facing the AI trade, what investors should be watching closely, and why he remains optimistic about the long-term AI infrastructure buildout despite growing concerns.

title: Why the Jensen Huang scandal is a 'net loss for China'

title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang scandal raises questions for AI leaders
summary:
Deirdre Bosa Live host Deirdre Bosa examines the developing controversy surrounding Nvidia (NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang amid allegations involving a woman suspected of passing information to Beijing.

Bosa is joined by Sierra CEO and co-founder and OpenAI Chairman Bret Taylor, alongside Sierra co-founder Clay Bavor, to discuss the potential fallout for Nvidia, the importance of trust in AI leadership, and what the controversy could mean for the broader AI ecosystem.
